name: Olivia Harrison
bio:
Olivia Harrison is a seasoned PR professional with a decade of experience shaping public perception and building brand awareness, particularly within the high-octane world of motorsports. Her journey began unconventionally, initially working in political communications before a chance encounter with a racing team owner ignited her passion for the sport. She quickly realized the critical role of effective PR in securing sponsorships and fan engagement. 

At EVO Racing Team, Olivia is responsible for crafting and executing comprehensive communication strategies. She is known for her meticulous attention to detail, her ability to anticipate potential crises, and her unwavering commitment to showcasing the team's accomplishments. Olivia is distinctive because she's not afraid to push boundaries and challenge conventional thinking to get the team noticed, but she also understands the need for a consistent and strategic approach. She also knows when to be a team player but has no fear of demanding more from her team.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail.
physical.description: Olivia has a warm smile and a perpetually focused expression, with a petite frame and an athletic build.

quirks: Insists on having a perfectly organized desk at all times.
Always has a detailed press release drafted at least 24 hours before any major announcement.
Starts every meeting with a brief meditation to center the team.
